constraints: Documentation and record only. $0.00. No code, run or key.

RECORD THE MILESTONE with its numbers and the arc, not the result alone: 084 COMPLETED 1/1, 9 calls, $0.06, validate 6/6, review ship:true; against -027 at 42 calls/$0.1783/no terminal, -049 at 12/$0.0527/no terminal, -071 at 12/$0.0287/no terminal. State that the successful run used fewer calls than every failing one.

STATE WHAT FIXED IT, named accurately and without credit inflation: a heterogeneous roster (a planning serving and a building serving, rather than one model for every tier), per-tier wired ceilings, and preferred-first failover. State plainly that the loop fixes (B18, D23/066, D24/067, D25) were necessary and were not the last blocker — the last blocker was serving selection.

RECORD THE UNOBSERVED, and this is the part a future reader would otherwise assume: ARCH-20260925-067 (rework carries the review findings) has NEVER fired on a live run, because 084 returned review ship:true and no rework ran. -066's stop_reason and -073's provider terminal were not exercised by this run either; both were observed on -071. Provider-free proof is not live proof and the two must not be conflated.

RECORD THE OWNER-RULED RUNS as a fact, not a deviation: runs 080-084 were iterated directly by the owner with pre-registrations committed and 'owner-ruled, no command file' stated in each. The owner holds the money (G-1/G-3) and acted within that authority; the channel is for code, and the live-run search was faster done hands-on. Give the elapsed time: 03:24 to 04:49.

FIX THE COST-FIGURE CORRUPTION, and record it as a finding: a cost written through a shell expands $0 to the shell's own name, so $0.06 became bash.06 in commit 3cb366e and $0.0287 became bash.0287 in PR #85. State the rule in AGENTS.md: cost figures written into a commit message or a generated body must be single-quoted or the dollar escaped; a corrupted cost figure reads as fine and is wrong (convention 26).
CORRECT THE EXISTING CORRUPTIONS by quotation — do not rewrite the commits. Note in the record what each corrupted figure should read.
Note the leftover branch arch/20260925-070-land-the-stack @ 93a1f722: contained in main, cosmetic, owner may delete.
Do NOT open a ledger row for anything. Do NOT change code, tests or workflows. Do NOT re-issue -072; D29/D30 remain unrecorded and that is stated, not silently skipped.
Every count re-derived against the tree (convention 24). Suite reported before and after.
